attire.title: Crimson Power Suit
attire.desc: attire: A sharply tailored, double-breasted power suit in vibrant crimson red virgin wool. The jacket features peak lapels, structured shoulders, and a nipped waist, paired with high-waisted, wide-leg trousers that pool elegantly at the ankle. Accessorized with a delicate gold chain necklace, a slim black patent leather belt, and sharp black pointed-toe stiletto heels. Hair pulled back in a sleek ponytail, with oversized black cat-eye sunglasses.

attire.title: Emerald Velvet Gown
attire.desc: attire: A floor-length, backless evening gown crafted from sumptuous emerald green crushed velvet. The dress features a deep cowl neck, spaghetti straps, and a dramatic thigh-high slit, creating a fluid, elegant silhouette. Paired with minimalist gold strappy sandals, a diamond tennis bracelet, and a small black velvet clutch bag. Subtle smoky eye makeup and loose, cascaded waves complete the look.

attire.title: Cyberpunk Latex Ensemble
attire.desc: attire: A striking two-piece ensemble featuring a glossy black latex cropped bustier with neon green piping and a high-waisted, form-fitting latex pencil skirt with matching neon accents along the seams. A chunky silver chain choker, fingerless leather gloves, and knee-high platform combat boots in black complete this edgy, futuristic look. Hair styled in a sharp, asymmetrical bob with vibrant green streaks.

attire.title: Bohemian Silk Kaftan
attire.desc: attire: A flowing, floor-length kaftan made from sheer ivory silk chiffon, adorned with intricate gold and turquoise embroidery in an ethnic pattern around the neckline and cuffs. The sleeves are wide and bell-shaped, and the waist is cinched with a braided leather belt featuring large turquoise stones. Accessorized with multiple layered gold necklaces, oversized hoop earrings, and flat leather sandals. Hair is long, loose, and naturally wavy.

attire.title: Architectural Tweed Coat
attire.desc: attire: An avant-garde, oversized coat crafted from charcoal grey Donegal tweed, featuring dramatic sculptural shoulders and an asymmetric hemline that sweeps to one side. The coat is worn over a simple black turtleneck and tailored black cigarette pants. Accessorized with structural silver cuff bracelets, black leather ankle boots with a geometric heel, and a minimalist black leather tote bag. Reading glasses with thick black frames.

attire.title: Monochromatic Minimalist
attire.desc: attire: A pristine, ivory white cashmere crew-neck sweater paired with high-waisted, wide-leg trousers in matching ivory wool crepe. The ensemble is defined by clean lines and an understated elegance. Accessorized with a single, delicate gold pendant necklace, small pearl stud earrings, and flat tan leather loafers. Hair pulled back into a sleek, low bun, with no-makeup makeup look.

attire.title: Gothic Lace Dress
attire.desc: attire: A floor-sweeping, long-sleeved gown crafted entirely from intricate black Chantilly lace, featuring a high neckline, a fitted bodice, and a full, voluminous skirt. A black velvet ribbon cinches the waist, and the dress is lined with a dark plum silk slip. Accessorized with a large silver crucifix pendant, multiple silver rings, and black velvet ankle boots with a block heel. Dark berry lipstick and dramatic winged eyeliner.

attire.title: Vintage Pin-Up Style
attire.desc: attire: A figure-hugging, cherry red satin wiggle dress with a sweetheart neckline and delicate ruching across the bust. The dress features a discreet back slit for ease of movement. Paired with white peep-toe stiletto heels, a small matching red clutch, and a string of faux pearls. Hair is styled in victory rolls, with bold red lipstick and a subtle cat-eye.

attire.title: Military-Inspired Uniform
attire.desc: attire: A sharply tailored olive drab cotton twill jacket with brass buttons, epaulets, and a cinched waist, worn over a crisp white button-down shirt. Paired with dark wash slim-fit jeans tucked into polished black leather combat boots. Accessorized with a wide brown leather belt, a vintage-inspired aviator watch, and dark tinted aviator sunglasses. Hair is neatly pulled back or cropped short.

attire.title: Artistic Deconstructed Denim
attire.desc: attire: A unique outfit featuring a deconstructed denim jacket in a faded indigo wash, reassembled with contrasting patches of lighter denim and raw edges, worn over a distressed white graphic t-shirt. Paired with high-waisted, wide-leg jeans with uneven cuffs and subtle paint splatters. Accessorized with a layered silver chain necklace, a canvas tote bag, and high-top canvas sneakers. A colourful beanie completes the urban artistic vibe.

attire.title: Retro Mod Mini Dress
attire.desc: attire: A vibrant tangerine orange A-line mini dress in thick ponte knit fabric, featuring a white Peter Pan collar and two oversized white buttons down the front. Paired with white go-go boots and large white circle earrings. Hair is styled in a sleek bob with blunt bangs. A simple white wrist clutch is held. The look is playful and iconic 1960s.

attire.title: Futuristic PVC Jumpsuit
attire.desc: attire: A form-fitting, iridescent silver PVC jumpsuit with long sleeves and a high collar, featuring black geometric cut-outs along the sides and arms. The material shimmers with hues of blue and purple. Paired with sleek black ankle boots with a transparent block heel and a minimalist silver cuff bracelet. Hair is styled in a high, slicked-back ponytail. A small, reflective clutch bag is carried.

attire.title: Romantic Chiffon Blouse
attire.desc: attire: A delicate blush pink chiffon blouse with voluminous bell sleeves, a ruffled high neck, and intricate lace detailing along the cuffs and yoke. Worn tucked into a high-waisted, flowy cream-colored maxi skirt made of crinkled silk. Accessorized with a single strand of pearls, delicate rose gold earrings, and nude pointed-toe ballet flats. Hair is soft, loose, and slightly curled.

attire.title: Urban Streetwear Set
attire.desc: attire: An oversized charcoal grey hoodie made from heavyweight fleece, featuring a large embroidered brand logo on the chest, paired with matching relaxed-fit joggers with elasticated cuffs. A crisp white t-shirt peeks out from underneath the hoodie. Accessorized with chunky white high-top sneakers, a black baseball cap worn backward, and a silver Cuban link chain. A black sling bag is worn across the chest.

attire.title: Glam Rock Sequin Outfit
attire.desc: attire: A dazzling outfit consisting of a cropped, long-sleeved jacket entirely covered in iridescent black sequins, worn over a sheer black mesh top. Paired with tight-fitting black faux leather trousers with silver zipper details. Accessorized with a wide studded belt, multiple silver rings, and black patent leather platform boots. Hair is big and teased, with dramatic glittery eye makeup.

attire.title: Equestrian Riding Attire
attire.desc: attire: A tailored navy blue riding jacket with brass buttons and a velvet collar, worn over a crisp white show shirt with a stock tie. Paired with beige breeches and highly polished black riding boots. Accessorized with a black velvet riding helmet, brown leather riding gloves, and a subtle horse-bit bracelet. The look is refined and classic.

attire.title: Nautical Striped Chic
attire.desc: attire: A classic navy and white striped Breton top in soft cotton, paired with high-waisted, wide-leg white linen trousers with a subtle pleat. A deep red silk scarf is tied loosely around the neck. Accessorized with a wide-brimmed straw hat, oversized round sunglasses, and espadrille wedge sandals. A large navy canvas tote bag with rope handles completes the coastal elegant look.

attire.title: Safari Adventure Wear
attire.desc: attire: A safari-style utility jumpsuit in light khaki linen, featuring multiple patch pockets, a drawstring waist, and rolled-up sleeves. Worn with a wide brown leather belt with a rustic buckle. Accessorized with dark brown leather ankle boots, a wide-brimmed felt hat, and a pair of vintage binoculars hanging around the neck. Hair is tied back in a practical ponytail.

attire.title: Parisian Chic Ensemble
attire.desc: attire: A perfectly tailored black wool blazer worn over a fitted black turtleneck sweater, paired with high-waisted, dark wash slim-fit jeans. A vibrant red silk scarf is tied elegantly around the neck. Accessorized with black leather ankle boots, a classic quilted black leather shoulder bag with a gold chain strap, and simple gold hoop earrings. Red lipstick and minimal makeup.

attire.title: Japanese Street Fashion
attire.desc: attire: An oversized, heavily embroidered souvenir jacket in satin with intricate dragon motifs on the back, worn open over a graphic t-shirt featuring anime characters. Paired with distressed baggy cargo pants and platform sneakers in vibrant colors. Accessorized with multiple layered necklaces, a bucket hat, and a colorful crossbody bag covered in patches and pins. Hair is dyed a bright, unconventional color.

attire.title: Sci-Fi Tech Wear
attire.desc: attire: A sleek, charcoal grey utility vest made from waterproof technical fabric with numerous zippered pockets and reflective detailing, worn over a long-sleeved black base layer. Paired with black cargo pants featuring reinforced knees and adjustable cuffs. Accessorized with high-top black tactical boots, fingerless gloves, and a face mask with integrated LED lights. A minimalist black backpack is worn.

attire.title: Victorian Steampunk
attire.desc: attire: A fitted dark brown faux leather corset with brass buckle details, worn over a cream-colored ruffled blouse with long bell sleeves. Paired with a floor-length, layered brown and black striped bustle skirt. Accessorized with a miniature top hat adorned with gears and feathers, goggles pushed up onto the forehead, and intricate bronze cog-wheel jewelry. Black Victorian-style lace-up boots.

attire.title: Abstract Geometric Print
attire.desc: attire: A sleeveless A-line dress in a bold, abstract geometric print featuring interlocking shapes in mustard yellow, deep teal, and charcoal grey. The fabric is a structured cotton poplin. Paired with simple black patent leather block-heel pumps and a minimalist black leather clutch. Accessorized with oversized square black sunglasses and geometric silver stud earrings. Hair is sleek and straight.

attire.title: Folkloric Embroidered Dress
attire.desc: attire: A loose-fitting, long-sleeved midi dress in natural undyed linen, heavily embroidered with colorful floral and animal motifs inspired by Eastern European folklore, particularly on the bodice and cuffs. A braided fabric belt cinches the waist. Paired with knee-high brown leather boots and a woven straw crossbody bag. Accessorized with a simple silver pendant and a floral headband. Hair is long and in loose braids.

attire.title: Disco Era Glam
attire.desc: attire: A shimmering gold lamé halter-neck jumpsuit with wide-leg flared trousers and a deep V-neckline. The fabric catches the light with every movement. Accessorized with oversized gold hoop earrings, multiple chunky gold bangles, and clear platform heels. Hair is big and bouncy, with glittery eyeshadow and a glossy nude lip. A small, beaded clutch is carried.

attire.title: Business Casual Smart
attire.desc: attire: A navy blue tailored blazer worn over a light blue button-down shirt, left untucked for a relaxed feel. Paired with slim-fit khaki chinos. Accessorized with a brown leather belt, a sophisticated chronograph wristwatch, and polished brown leather loafers. A pair of stylish reading glasses rests on a lapel. The look is approachable yet professional.

attire.title: Athleisure Luxe
attire.desc: attire: A matching set consisting of a cropped, mock-neck sweatshirt and high-waisted leggings, both in a luxurious charcoal grey stretch knit fabric with subtle metallic threading. A long, streamlined trench coat in a complementary light grey drapes over the shoulders. Accessorized with designer white sneakers with a chunky sole, a sleek black fanny pack worn crossbody, and minimalist silver earrings. Hair is in a high ponytail.

attire.title: Couture Ball Gown
attire.desc: attire: An exquisite, voluminous ball gown in deep sapphire blue silk duchess satin, featuring an intricately ruched bodice with delicate off-the-shoulder straps and a dramatically full, floor-sweeping skirt with a long train. Adorned with subtle hand-embroidered crystal details along the neckline. Accessorized with a diamond choker necklace, matching diamond drop earrings, and a small blue satin clutch. Elegant updo and sophisticated makeup.

attire.title: Androgynous Tailoring
attire.desc: attire: An impeccably tailored, oversized single-breasted blazer in a muted grey pinstripe wool, worn over a crisp white oversized button-down shirt. Paired with matching wide-leg pleated trousers. Accessorized with a thin black leather tie, polished black leather derby shoes, and a minimalist silver watch. Hair is neatly slicked back. The overall silhouette is strong and clean.

attire.title: Festival Bohemian
attire.desc: attire: A flowing white lace crop top with bell sleeves and an off-the-shoulder neckline, paired with high-waisted denim cut-off shorts with frayed edges. A long, sheer floral-print kimono drapes over the ensemble. Accessorized with multiple layered coin necklaces, feather earrings, a wide-brimmed felt hat, and studded ankle boots. Hair is long, braided, and adorned with flowers.

attire.title: Dark Academia Look
attire.desc: attire: A vintage-inspired dark forest green tweed blazer with elbow patches, worn over a light academia cream-colored cable-knit sweater and a crisp white collared shirt. Paired with tailored brown corduroy trousers. Accessorized with round reading glasses, a leather satchel filled with books, and polished dark brown brogues. A subtle plaid scarf is loosely tied.

attire.title: Preppy Collegiate Style
attire.desc: attire: A navy blue V-neck sweater vest with red and white stripe detailing at the neck, worn over a classic white oxford shirt. Paired with a pleated plaid mini skirt in coordinating navy, red, and white. Accessorized with white knee-high socks, polished black loafers, and a structured leather backpack. Hair is styled in a neat ponytail with a matching scrunchie.

attire.title: Western Cowgirl Glam
attire.desc: attire: A fitted, distressed denim shirt with pearl snap buttons, tied at the waist, worn over a sequined camisole top. Paired with high-waisted white flared jeans with intricate embroidery along the hem. Accessorized with a wide-brimmed white cowboy hat, silver concho belt, and knee-high white leather cowboy boots. A statement turquoise necklace and matching earrings complete the look.

attire.title: Hollywood Red Carpet
attire.desc: attire: A breathtaking off-the-shoulder gown in liquid gold satin, featuring elegant draping across the bodice, a cinched waist, and a dramatic mermaid silhouette that flares into a sweeping train. The fabric gleams under the lights. Accessorized with an elaborate diamond necklace, matching drop earrings, and a sparkling gold clutch. Hair is styled in classic old Hollywood waves.

attire.title: Avant-Garde Draping
attire.desc: attire: An architectural dress crafted from stiff black neoprene, featuring asymmetric draping that creates sculptural folds and angles around the body, particularly across one shoulder and down to an uneven hemline. The silhouette is bold and unconventional. Paired with black leather thigh-high boots and abstract silver statement earrings. Hair is slicked back into a severe bun.

attire.title: Pastel Goth Aesthetic
attire.desc: attire: A cropped baby pink velvet bralette worn under a sheer black mesh long-sleeved top with subtle spiderweb embroidery. Paired with a high-waisted black pleated mini skirt adorned with silver chain details. Accessorized with fishnet stockings, chunky black platform boots, a pastel pink choker with an O-ring, and multiple silver skull rings. Hair is dyed pastel lavender with dark roots.

attire.title: Royal Blue Brocade
attire.desc: attire: A sophisticated, structured cocktail dress in rich royal blue brocade fabric with an intricate floral pattern woven in gold thread. The dress features a high boat neck, three-quarter sleeves, and an A-line silhouette that falls just above the knee. Accessorized with nude pointed-toe stiletto heels, a small gold clutch, and delicate gold stud earrings. Hair is styled in a classic chignon.

attire.title: Forest Green Hunter
attire.desc: attire: A luxurious forest green cashmere turtleneck sweater, paired with tailored dark brown leather skinny pants. A long, camel-colored wool coat is draped elegantly over the shoulders. Accessorized with polished brown leather riding boots, a large gold-faced watch, and a subtle pearl necklace. A structured brown leather handbag is carried. The look exudes quiet luxury.

attire.title: Ivory Bridal Inspired
attire.desc: attire: An ethereal, floor-length gown in delicate ivory French lace over a champagne silk slip, featuring a deep V-neckline, long illusion sleeves, and intricate floral appliqué throughout. The skirt flows softly into a small train. Accessorized with minimalist diamond earrings, a delicate pearl and crystal hair vine, and nude satin heels. A small bouquet of white roses is carried.

attire.title: Midnight Blue Tuxedo
attire.desc: attire: A sharply tailored women's tuxedo in lustrous midnight blue silk faille, featuring a peak-lapel jacket with satin trim and perfectly cut slim-fit trousers. Worn over a crisp white silk camisole. Accessorized with black patent leather stiletto pumps, a delicate silver lariat necklace, and a small black velvet clutch. Hair is sleek and sophisticated, with a bold red lip.

attire.title: Desert Nomad Robe
attire.desc: attire: A voluminous, floor-length robe made from natural unbleached linen in a sandy beige hue, featuring wide sleeves, a deep hood, and subtle hand-stitched detailing. Worn over a simple white cotton tunic and loose-fitting linen trousers. Accessorized with multiple layered silver and turquoise necklaces, a wide brown leather belt, and comfortable leather sandals. A large woven straw bag is carried.

attire.title: Space Age Silver
attire.desc: attire: A futuristic mini-dress crafted from shimmering metallic silver PVC, with a high collar, geometric paneling, and a slight A-line cut. The fabric reflects light with a liquid-like quality. Paired with knee-high white go-go boots and oversized silver spherical earrings. Hair is styled in a gravity-defying, slicked-back high ponytail. The look is bold and retro-futuristic.

attire.title: Art Deco Flapper
attire.desc: attire: A sparkling champagne gold sequined shift dress with intricate beaded fringe details cascading from the hem and sleeves. The dress features a dropped waist and a bateau neckline. Accessorized with a long string of pearls, an ornate feathered headband, and T-strap low-heel dancing shoes. Hair is styled in a short, elegant bob with finger waves. A small, beaded clutch is carried.

attire.title: Tropical Resort Wear
attire.desc: attire: A flowing two-piece set featuring a cropped, off-the-shoulder top with voluminous sleeves and a matching high-waisted maxi skirt with a dramatic side slit, both in a vibrant hibiscus floral print on a turquoise background. Accessorized with a wide-brimmed straw hat, oversized white sunglasses, flat jeweled sandals, and a woven tote bag. Hair is loose and beachy.

attire.title: Sporty Cropped Set
attire.desc: attire: A matching athletic set consisting of a high-neck, long-sleeved cropped top and high-waisted biker shorts in a bold cobalt blue stretch fabric. A lightweight, oversized black windbreaker jacket is tied around the waist. Accessorized with chunky white athletic sneakers, a black baseball cap, and a minimalist black fanny pack. Hair is in a sleek high ponytail.

attire.title: Baroque Opulence
attire.desc: attire: A sumptuous gown in dark red and gold brocade, featuring a fitted boned bodice, a dramatic sweetheart neckline, and voluminous puffed sleeves. The full skirt is adorned with intricate gold embroidery and velvet trim. Accessorized with a multi-strand pearl and gold necklace, large ornate gold chandelier earrings, and black velvet opera gloves. Hair is styled in an elaborate updo with jeweled pins.

attire.title: Pop Art Inspired
attire.desc: attire: A vibrant, knee-length shift dress in a bold primary color, such as bright yellow, featuring oversized black comic-book style outline prints of facial features (e.g., a single eye or a mouth). The fabric is a crisp cotton. Paired with black opaque tights and black patent leather Mary Jane shoes. Accessorized with a chunky black and white polka dot headband and large, circular black earrings. The look is graphic and playful.

attire.title: Grunge Revival
attire.desc: attire: An oversized, distressed flannel shirt in a red and black plaid pattern, worn open over a faded band t-shirt featuring a vintage rock logo. Paired with ripped black skinny jeans. Accessorized with chunky black combat boots, a wide studded belt, a silver chain wallet, and a messy beanie. Hair is unkempt and dyed a dark, unnatural shade like deep purple.

attire.title: Sleek Leather Moto
attire.desc: attire: A fitted black leather motorcycle jacket with silver hardware and zipper details, worn over a simple white crew-neck t-shirt. Paired with high-waisted black faux leather leggings. Accessorized with black leather ankle boots, a classic silver wristwatch, and oversized black aviator sunglasses. A black leather crossbody bag with chain detailing is carried. The look is effortlessly cool and edgy.

attire.title: Whimsical Fairytale
attire.desc: attire: A whimsical, ethereal gown crafted from layers of pale lavender and mint green tulle, featuring a sweetheart neckline, delicate off-the-shoulder straps, and a bodice adorned with embroidered silver stars and tiny faux pearls. The full, floating skirt has iridescent glitter details. Accessorized with a delicate silver tiara, sparkling stud earrings, and clear glass slippers. Hair is long, wavy, and adorned with subtle floral pins.

attire.title: Velvet Noir Gown
attire.desc: attire: A dramatic, floor-length gown crafted from sumptuous midnight blue velvet, featuring a deep V-neckline, long bishop sleeves with buttoned cuffs, and a thigh-high slit. Accessorized with opera-length black leather gloves, a diamond choker, and obsidian stiletto heels.

attire.title: Cyberpunk Nomad Trench
attire.desc: attire: An oversized, distressed black PVC trench coat with neon green reflective piping, worn over a charcoal grey technical fabric jumpsuit. Paired with chunky platform combat boots, multiple silver chain necklaces, and a pair of futuristic orange-tinted visors.

attire.title: Regal Brocade Suit
attire.desc: attire: A tailored, structured blazer and matching wide-leg trousers in a rich emerald green brocade fabric, intricately patterned with gold filigree. Worn over a sheer black lace camisole, complemented by a statement gold belt, and pointed patent leather flats.

attire.title: Latex Fetish Catsuit
attire.desc: attire: A skintight, ruby red latex catsuit with a full-length zipper down the front, featuring a high collar and long sleeves. Accessorized with matching latex over-the-knee boots, a wide black leather harness, and a slicked-back ponytail.

attire.title: Tweed Elegance Set
attire.desc: attire: A classic Chanel-inspired tweed suit in a delicate cream and rose pink blend, comprising a cropped, collarless jacket with pearl buttons and a matching A-line mini skirt. Paired with sheer black stockings, small pearl stud earrings, and kitten-heel slingbacks.

attire.title: Gothic Romance Gown
attire.desc: attire: A flowing, off-the-shoulder gown made from black Chantilly lace over a deep plum silk lining, featuring a cinched waist with a velvet ribbon and a dramatic train. Accessorized with a silver filigree cross pendant, dark red lipstick, and velvet ankle boots.

attire.title: Sequin Siren Dress
attire.desc: attire: A dazzling, form-fitting midi dress entirely covered in iridescent sapphire blue sequins, with a low-cut cowl neckline and delicate spaghetti straps. Finished with minimalist silver drop earrings, a matching sequined clutch, and strappy silver high heels.

attire.title: Utility Chic Jumpsuit
attire.desc: attire: A safari-inspired jumpsuit in a refined olive green linen, featuring multiple patch pockets, a drawstring waist, and rolled-up sleeves. Accessorized with a woven leather belt, chunky gold hoop earrings, and beige espadrille wedges.

attire.title: PVC Punk Mini
attire.desc: attire: A glossy black PVC mini skirt paired with a torn, oversized band t-shirt and a studded leather biker jacket. Completed with fishnet stockings, heavy black combat boots, and a spiked choker necklace.

attire.title: Boho Luxe Maxi
attire.desc: attire: A tiered maxi dress in a flowing, patterned silk chiffon with an abstract floral print in warm ochre, rust, and cream tones. Layered with a distressed denim vest, a wide-brimmed felt hat, and multiple beaded bracelets.

attire.title: Tailored Power Suit
attire.desc: attire: A sharply tailored, double-breasted suit in a deep charcoal grey pinstripe wool, featuring a fitted blazer and high-waisted wide-leg trousers. Worn with a crisp white button-down shirt, a skinny black tie, and polished black leather oxfords.

attire.title: Silk Slip Dream
attire.desc: attire: A delicate, bias-cut midi slip dress in a shimmering champagne silk, featuring a cowl neck and thin spaghetti straps. Layered under an oversized, unbuttoned cream cashmere cardigan, with a single delicate gold chain necklace and nude block heels.

attire.title: Faux Fur Fantasy
attire.desc: attire: An extravagant, floor-length faux fur coat in a vibrant electric blue, worn over a simple black bodycon mini dress. Accessorized with oversized silver hoop earrings, opaque black tights, and platform knee-high boots.

attire.title: Denim Deconstructed
attire.desc: attire: A patchwork denim jacket with frayed edges and embroidered details, paired with high-waisted, distressed boyfriend jeans. Worn over a plain white ribbed tank top, with chunky white sneakers and a baseball cap.

attire.title: Victorian Ghost Gown
attire.desc: attire: A floor-sweeping gown made from antique white lace and sheer organza, featuring a high ruffled neck, long puff sleeves, and intricate pearl button detailing down the back. Paired with delicate white satin gloves and a small silver locket.

attire.title: Minimalist Structure
attire.desc: attire: A sleeveless, architectural dress in heavy cream cotton twill, featuring a clean A-line silhouette, a high boat neck, and subtle pleating details. Accessorized with a wide tan leather belt, a geometric gold cuff bracelet, and pointed nude flats.

attire.title: Metallic Glaze Mini
attire.desc: attire: A shimmering silver lamé mini dress with a one-shoulder design and ruched detailing, creating a sculpted silhouette. Paired with clear PVC heels, a metallic silver clutch, and minimalist diamond stud earrings.

attire.title: Preppy Academia
attire.desc: attire: A plaid pleated mini skirt in navy and forest green, worn with a crisp white collared shirt under a V-neck argyle sweater vest. Accessorized with knee-high socks, polished loafers, and a pair of sophisticated reading glasses.

attire.title: Leather Dominatrix
attire.desc: attire: A form-fitting black leather corset top with a structured boning and a pointed hem, paired with high-waisted, straight-leg leather trousers. Accessorized with spiked stiletto boots, a choker with a large silver O-ring, and dark, smoky eye makeup.

attire.title: Tropical Resort Caftan
attire.desc: attire: A flowing caftan made from luxurious silk twill, printed with vibrant hibiscus flowers and lush green foliage on a turquoise background. Worn over a minimalist white swimsuit, with wide-brimmed straw hat and embellished flat sandals.

attire.title: Sporty Luxe Track
attire.desc: attire: A tailored track suit in a sophisticated navy blue silk blend, featuring white racing stripes down the sides, worn with a cropped white bralette. Paired with designer white sneakers, a sleek high ponytail, and a minimalist silver watch.

attire.title: Cottagecore Dream
attire.desc: attire: A voluminous, tiered midi dress in a delicate pastel yellow linen, featuring puffed sleeves, a square neckline, and intricate white eyelet lace trim. Accessorized with a woven straw basket bag, simple white canvas espadrilles, and a floral headscarf.

attire.title: Glam Rock Star
attire.desc: attire: Skinny black pleather pants, a sequined silver tank top, and an open, oversized blazer in a leopard print velvet. Completed with studded ankle boots, multiple silver rings, and a bold red lip.

attire.title: Minimalist Knit Dress
attire.desc: attire: A long-sleeved, high-neck midi dress crafted from a fine gauge, ribbed cashmere in a subtle heather grey, hugging the figure gently. Accessorized with a delicate gold pendant necklace, a small leather cross-body bag, and sleek white low-top sneakers.

attire.title: Architectural Gown
attire.desc: attire: A floor-length, sculptural gown in stiff, optic white duchesse satin, featuring dramatic folds and a structured, off-the-shoulder neckline that creates a striking silhouette. Paired with invisible heels and a single, oversized pearl earring.

attire.title: Preppy Chic Ensemble
attire.desc: attire: A crisp white collared shirt layered under a navy blue cable-knit sweater, paired with tailored beige chino shorts. Accessorized with a brown leather belt, boat shoes, and a classic canvas tote bag.

attire.title: Sheer Fantasy Gown
attire.desc: attire: A transparent, floor-length gown made from delicate black tulle and intricate lace appliqués, strategically placed to create an ethereal, revealing silhouette. Worn over high-waisted black briefs and a bandeau top, with black barely-there sandals.

attire.title: Denim Jumpsuit
attire.desc: attire: A fitted, dark wash denim jumpsuit with a zipper front, pointed collar, and utility pockets, featuring a wide-leg cut. Accessorized with a thick tan leather belt, chunky gold hoop earrings, and platform clogs.

attire.title: Avant-Garde Drape
attire.desc: attire: A voluminous, asymmetrical dress crafted from a single piece of flowing crimson silk chiffon, expertly draped and folded to create an otherworldly, sculptural silhouette. Paired with minimalist black ankle boots and no visible accessories.

attire.title: Punk Rock Rebel
attire.desc: attire: A distressed black denim jacket covered in band patches and safety pins, worn over a ripped graphic t-shirt. Paired with plaid bondage pants featuring metal chains and buckles, and heavy Doc Martens.

attire.title: Bohemian Witch

Paired with high-waisted, tailored trousers in a matching navy. Worn with a sheer black lace camisole underneath, black stiletto pumps, and a geometric silver necklace, blending corporate with edgy.

attire.title: Sequined Jumpsuit
attire.desc: attire: A dazzling, form-fitting wide-leg jumpsuit entirely covered in shimmering emerald green sequins, featuring a deep V-neckline and long sleeves. The jumpsuit catches and reflects light with spectacular effect. Paired with black platform heels, large gold hoop earrings, and a small black velvet clutch, for a glamorous and show-stopping party outfit.

attire.title: Tweed Mini Dress
attire.desc: attire: A sophisticated yet playful mini dress crafted from a textured pink and white tweed fabric, featuring a sleeveless A-line cut, a rounded neckline, and decorative pearl buttons down the front. Paired with opaque white tights, light pink patent leather Mary Jane heels, and a small, structured top-handle bag, embodying a chic, youthful elegance.

attire.title: Printed Chiffon Blouse
attire.desc: attire: A delicate, ethereal blouse made from sheer black chiffon, adorned with an intricate pattern of celestial bodies – stars, moons, and constellations – in shimmering silver thread. Features a ruffled high collar and long, voluminous sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Tucked into a high-waisted black leather pencil skirt, paired with black stiletto ankle boots and a minimalist silver crescent moon necklace.

attire.title: Quilted Bomber Jacket
attire.desc: attire: A stylish, oversized bomber jacket made from quilted satin in a rich burgundy color, featuring ribbed cuffs and collar. Worn over a simple white crew-neck t-shirt. Paired with distressed black skinny jeans, chunky white platform sneakers, and a black beanie hat, for a comfortable yet fashionable urban street style.

attire.title: Embellished Corset Top
attire.desc: attire: A dramatic, structured corset top in black satin, heavily embellished with intricate silver beadwork and tiny crystals, creating a glittering effect. Paired with high-waisted, wide-leg tailored trousers in a deep charcoal grey. Accessories include delicate silver drop earrings, a minimalist black clutch, and black pointed-toe pumps, for a blend of opulence and sophistication.

attire.title: Faux Fur Coat
attire.desc: attire: A luxurious, oversized faux fur coat in a striking leopard print, reaching mid-calf. Worn over a sleek, form-fitting black turtleneck dress made from fine merino wool. Paired with tall black leather boots, large gold hoop earrings, and a vintage black leather shoulder bag, exuding old Hollywood glamour with a modern twist.

attire.title: Plaid Flannel Shirt
attire.desc: attire: A classic, oversized red and black buffalo plaid flannel shirt, worn open over a plain white t-shirt. Paired with faded blue ripped jeans and sturdy black work boots. Accessorized with a simple silver chain and a black trucker hat, for a relaxed, grunge-inspired, and effortlessly cool aesthetic.

attire.title: Velvet Blazer Dress
attire.desc: attire: A chic, double-breasted blazer dress crafted from rich navy blue velvet, featuring sharp peak lapels and gold-tone buttons. The dress is tailored to create a flattering, slightly A-line silhouette, reaching mid-thigh. Paired with sheer black patterned tights, black suede over-the-knee boots, and a minimalist gold choker, for an elegant and powerful evening statement.

attire.title: Distressed Knit Sweater
attire.desc: attire: An avant-garde, heavily distressed and oversized black knit sweater, featuring deliberate rips, laddering, and fraying, exposing glimpses of skin. Worn over a simple black slip dress. Paired with chunky black platform boots, multiple silver rings, and a dark, moody lip color, for a high-fashion grunge aesthetic.

attire.title: Satin Cargo Pants
attire.desc: attire: A pair of luxurious yet casual cargo pants made from sleek, oyster white satin, featuring large utility pockets and a relaxed, slightly tapered fit. Paired with a cropped white ribbed tank top and an oversized beige trench coat. Accessorized with white leather sneakers, a delicate gold chain necklace, and a minimalist tote bag, blending comfort with refined style.

attire.title: Geometric Print Dress
attire.desc: attire: A striking midi dress with a bold, angular geometric print in contrasting black and white, featuring a high neckline and long, fitted sleeves. The print creates an optical illusion effect. Paired with sharp black stiletto pumps, a structured black clutch, and minimalist silver earrings, for a modern, art-inspired, and graphic look.

attire.title: Transparent Lace Top
attire.desc: attire: A delicate, entirely sheer black lace long-sleeve top with intricate floral patterns, worn over a black bralette. Tucked into high-waisted, tailored faux leather trousers in a deep burgundy. Accessorized with black pointed-toe ankle boots, a minimalist silver necklace, and a small, chained shoulder bag, creating a balance of daring and sophisticated.

attire.title: Cropped Tweed Jacket
attire.desc: attire: A chic, cropped tweed jacket in a vibrant royal blue and white weave, featuring frayed edges, decorative pearl buttons, and a rounded neckline. Worn over a simple white camisole. Paired with high-waisted white denim jeans, light blue suede pumps, and a small, quilted white chain bag, for a fresh and elegant daytime ensemble.

attire.title: Pleather Mini Skirt
attire.desc: attire: A high-waisted, A-line mini skirt crafted from glossy black pleather, featuring a visible silver zipper down the front. Paired with a fitted, long-sleeve black mesh top layered over a black bandeau. Accessorized with chunky black platform boots, fishnet stockings, and a thick silver chain necklace, embodying an edgy, rock-inspired style.

Brass goggles are perched on a brown leather top hat. Lace-up Victorian boots and gear-motif jewelry complete the adventurous inventor aesthetic.

attire.title: Haute Couture Mermaid
attire.desc: attire: A shimmering teal sequined backless evening gown, form-fitting through the bodice and hips, then flaring dramatically at the knee into a voluminous, iridescent train. A seashell-motif clutch and clear stiletto heels with subtle blue tints enhance the aquatic theme.

attire.title: Preppy Academic
attire.desc: attire: A navy blue tailored blazer with polished gold buttons, worn over a crisp white oxford shirt. A grey tweed pencil skirt provides a classic silhouette. Argyle socks, polished brown leather loafers, and thick-rimmed reading glasses complete the scholarly yet stylish look.

attire.title: Gothic Lolita
attire.desc: attire: A black and white striped ruffle dress with a full, voluminous skirt, layered over a white lace petticoat. Knee-high lace-up platform boots, a black velvet bow headband, and a delicate black lace parasol complete the elegant yet dark aesthetic.

attire.title: Dystopian Survivor
attire.desc: attire: A heavily distressed khaki trench coat, layered over a ripped grey t-shirt and patched dark denim jeans. Fingerless leather gloves, heavy duty combat boots, and a practical respirator mask attached to a belt complete the gritty, post-apocalyptic look.

attire.title: Glam Rock Icon
attire.desc: attire: A skin-tight metallic gold jumpsuit with a wide, studded belt. Platform boots with glitter accents. An oversized, shaggy faux fur coat. Multiple layered gold chains and a dramatic smoky eye makeup look complete the flamboyant stage presence.

attire.title: Renaissance Festival Queen
attire.desc: attire: A deep burgundy velvet gown with wide, ornate sleeves and intricate gold embroidery along the bodice and skirt. A detailed golden headpiece adorned with pearls. A wide, jeweled belt. Period-appropriate flat leather shoes complete the regal, historical ensemble.

attire.title: Yacht Club Sophisticate

attire.title: Vampire Noble
attire.desc: attire: A floor-length black velvet cape with a dramatic crimson silk lining, draped over a perfectly tailored black suit. A white ruffled shirt with lace cuffs. A silver skull-head cane and highly polished patent leather dress shoes add to the aristocratic and dark presence.

attire.title: Cosmic Cowgirl
attire.desc: attire: Holographic silver cowboy boots that catch the light, paired with distressed denim cut-offs featuring a sequined fringe. A matching sequined crop top. An iridescent Western belt with a large buckle. A wide-brimmed white hat adorned with celestial pins.

attire.title: Rococo Rebel

attire.title: Techwear Assassin

attire.title: Hollywood Golden Age

attire.title: Tropical Explorer

Paired with pristine white go-go boots and thick white tights. Accessories include oversized round sunglasses, large geometric drop earrings in black and white, and a sleek, short bob haircut.

attire.title: Punk Rock Princess
attire.desc: attire: A heavily distressed black denim jacket adorned with silver studs and band patches, worn over a vintage band t-shirt. Paired with a red and black plaid mini-skirt, fishnet stockings, and scuffed black Doc Martens. Accessorized with safety pin earrings, a spiked choker, and a chain wallet attached to the belt loop.

attire.title: Baroque Extravagance
attire.desc: attire: A structured corset top in deep sapphire blue brocade with intricate gold embroidery and boning. Paired with a voluminous, floor-length taffeta skirt in a matching sapphire, featuring dramatic pleats. Accompanied by opera-length black velvet gloves, a pearl and gold statement necklace, and elaborate updo adorned with a small tiara.

attire.title: Minimalist Architect
attire.desc: attire: A sleek, structured cream wool coat with clean lines and hidden buttons, falling to mid-calf. Worn over a fine-knit black turtleneck sweater and wide-leg, high-waisted charcoal grey trousers. Paired with polished black leather loafers. Accessorized with a single, delicate gold chain necklace and a minimalist black leather tote bag.

attire.title: Retro Future
attire.desc: attire: A cropped, silver metallic bomber jacket with ribbed cuffs and collar, featuring a prominent 'retro-futuristic' logo on the back. Worn over a pastel pink PVC pencil skirt that gleams under light. Paired with pristine white knee-high go-go boots. Accessorized with clear visor sunglasses and large, silver hoop earrings.

attire.title: Equestrian Elegance
attire.desc: attire: A perfectly tailored tweed blazer in a forest green and brown check pattern, with leather elbow patches. Worn over a crisp white riding shirt with a high collar. Paired with form-fitting, dark brown stretch jodhpurs and knee-high polished black leather riding boots. Accessorized with a silk scarf tied at the neck and a delicate wristwatch.

attire.title: Disco Inferno
attire.desc: attire: A shimmering silver lamé halter jumpsuit with a deep V-neckline and dramatically wide, flowing legs. The fabric catches every light, creating a dazzling effect. Paired with towering platform heels. Accessorized with oversized hoop earrings, a stack of rhinestone bracelets, and a sparkly clutch bag.

attire.title: Gilded Age Debutante
attire.desc: attire: An exquisite ivory satin ball gown with a voluminous skirt and intricate beadwork and lace appliqué on the bodice. Features off-the-shoulder sleeves and a delicate sweetheart neckline. Accompanied by long white satin gloves, a sparkling diamond tiara, and a delicate hand fan. Hair styled in soft, elegant curls.

attire.title: Techwear Ninja
attire.desc: attire: Loose-fitting black functional cargo pants with multiple asymmetrical pockets and reinforced panels. Paired with an asymmetrical zip-up jacket in a matte black technical fabric, featuring integrated hood and thumbholes. A tactical vest with modular pouches is worn over the jacket. High-top black sneakers and a black balaclava complete the look.

attire.title: Parisian Muse
attire.desc: attire: A classic navy and white striped Breton top in a fine cotton knit. Paired with high-waisted, dark wash slim-fit jeans. A sophisticated camel-colored trench coat is draped over the shoulders. Accessorized with bright red ballet flats, a small silk neck scarf tied loosely, and a sleek black leather crossbody bag.

attire.title: Fetish Noir
attire.desc: attire: A glossy black latex catsuit that hugs every curve, featuring a full-length zipper down the front and a high collar. Paired with high-heeled ankle boots made of patent leather with a sharp, pointed toe. Accessories include a spiked choker, long patent leather gloves, and a tight, slicked-back ponytail.

attire.title: Resort Glamour
attire.desc: attire: A flowing emerald green silk kaftan with wide, billowy sleeves and a deep V-neckline, adorned with subtle gold embroidery. Paired with flat, jeweled sandals. Accessories include a wide-brimmed straw hat, oversized white-framed sunglasses, and a large, beaded clutch bag.

attire.title: Woodland Fairy
attire.desc: attire: A pale green chiffon gown with multiple layers, creating a soft, ethereal flow, intricately embroidered with delicate floral and vine motifs. Hair adorned with a natural leaf crown interwoven with tiny white blossoms. Barefoot, with delicate silver arm cuffs resembling twisting branches and subtle glitter on the skin.

attire.title: Space Explorer
attire.desc: attire: A pristine white quilted jumpsuit with silver metallic accents on the shoulders and knees, featuring multiple zippers and a fitted silhouette. A clear, spherical helmet with a visible communication device is worn. Paired with bulky, white 'moon boots'. A utility belt with various gadgets completes the look.

attire.title: Steampunk Inventor
attire.desc: attire: A fitted brown leather corset over a ruffled Victorian blouse in cream lace. Paired with pinstriped trousers tucked into sturdy leather ankle boots. Accessories include a pair of functional brass goggles perched on the forehead, a gears-and-cogs necklace, and a utility belt with small pouches and tools.

attire.title: Pop Art Vixen
attire.desc: attire: A bright yellow shift dress with bold black outlines mimicking a comic book style, featuring a simple round neckline and short sleeves. Paired with chunky white go-go boots. Accessorized with oversized geometric earrings in black and white, and a vibrant red lipstick.

attire.title: Avant-Garde Sculptural
attire.desc: attire: An architectural dress constructed from overlapping panels of stiff white cotton, creating a dynamic, voluminous silhouette with sharp angles and an asymmetrical hem. Paired with clear perspex heels that give the illusion of floating. Accessorized with minimalist silver cuff bracelets and a sleek, geometric updo.

attire.title: Miami Vice Chic
attire.desc: attire: A loose-fitting pastel pink linen suit, consisting of an oversized blazer and matching wide-leg trousers. Worn over a vibrant teal silk camisole. Paired with pristine white leather loafers. Accessories include classic aviator sunglasses and a chunky gold chain necklace.

attire.title: Rococo Revival
attire.desc: attire: A dramatic powder blue silk gown with elaborate ruffles, bows, and delicate floral embroidery, featuring a wide, structured skirt. Accompanied by a towering white powdered wig adorned with feathers and ribbons. Accessorized with pearl drop earrings and a delicate hand fan. Gloves in matching blue lace.

attire.title: Deep Sea Enchantress
attire.desc: attire: An iridescent, scale-like fabric mermaid gown in shimmering shades of deep blue, emerald green, and violet, hugging the figure before flaring dramatically at the knees. A shell-inspired headpiece with delicate pearls adorns the hair. Accessorized with intricate pearl earrings and a shimmering, dewy makeup look.

attire.title: Retro Sporty
attire.desc: attire: A vibrant orange tracksuit with classic white racing stripes down the arms and legs, made from a glossy polyester fabric. Paired with chunky white sneakers and white ankle socks. Accessories include a white visor, large gold hoop earrings, and a high ponytail.

attire.title: Bohemian Wanderer
attire.desc: attire: A flowing maxi skirt with an intricate ethnic print in warm reds, oranges, and purples. Paired with an embroidered off-white crop top and a distressed denim vest. Accessorized with a fringed suede crossbody bag, multiple stacked bracelets, and flat leather sandals. Hair is long and wavy with a braided headband.

attire.title: Victorian Detective
attire.desc: attire: A dark grey wool cape with a high collar, worn over a plaid waistcoat and a crisp white shirt with a loosened tie. Paired with slim-fit black trousers and polished leather boots. Accessories include black leather gloves, a silver pocket watch on a chain, and a magnifying glass held in hand.

attire.title: Glam Rock Diva
attire.desc: attire: A cropped, silver studded black leather jacket worn over a sequined tank top that shimmers with every move. Paired with black ripped skinny jeans and towering platform boots. Accessorized with heavy kohl eyeliner, dark lipstick, and a mass of teased, voluminous hair.

attire.title: Renaissance Faire
attire.desc: attire: A deep green velvet gown with rich gold trim and wide, flowing sleeves. Worn over a white chemise with a ruffled neckline. A laced corset in dark brown leather cinches the waist. Accessorized with a jeweled circlet, a leather pouch at the hip, and soft, low-heeled leather boots.

attire.title: New Wave Artist
attire.desc: attire: An oversized black blazer with wide shoulder pads, worn over a graphic t-shirt featuring abstract art. Paired with wide-leg, acid wash jeans rolled at the ankle. A bright red beret sits atop short, spiky hair. Accessorized with chunky black Doc Martens and a collection of enamel pins on the blazer lapel.

attire.title: Desert Sorceress
attire.desc: attire: A flowing black sheer chiffon cape, worn over a distressed leather bralette and wide-leg linen trousers in a sandy beige. Accessorized with large, intricate silver amulets and layered chain necklaces. Hair is long and wild, adorned with feathers. Bare feet are adorned with delicate ankle chains.

attire.title: Parisian Street Style
attire.desc: attire: A sophisticated camel-colored wool coat with a classic straight cut, worn open over a fine-knit black turtleneck sweater. Paired with slim-fit black tailored trousers that hit just above the ankle. Pristine white leather sneakers add a touch of casual chic. Accessorized with a small, structured black crossbody bag.

attire.title: Futuristic Geisha
attire.desc: attire: A kimono-inspired dress crafted from metallic silver silk, featuring wide sleeves and a high collar. A wide obi belt with holographic elements cinches the waist. Paired with platform tabi boots. Hair is styled in an elaborate, sculptural updo adorned with intricate silver and crystal ornaments.

attire.title: Post-Apocalyptic Survivor
attire.desc: attire: Layered distressed denim and canvas, consisting of a patched-up denim jacket over a ripped, dark grey thermal shirt. Paired with heavily patched cargo pants and sturdy, oil-stained combat boots. Accessories include fingerless leather gloves, a makeshift utility belt, and a gas mask hanging from the hip.

attire.title: English Countryside
attire.desc: attire: A quilted waxed jacket in a deep olive green, with a corduroy collar. Worn over a chunky knit cream sweater. Paired with thick corduroy trousers in a dark brown and wellington boots. Accessorized with a tweed flat cap and a leather shoulder bag.

attire.title: Ethereal Goddess
attire.desc: attire: A gracefully draped white pleated chiffon gown with a flowing silhouette and a deep V-neckline. Features delicate gold leaf armbands spiraling up the arms. A simple gold circlet adorns the head, and delicate gold sandals complete the look. Hair is long, wavy, and free-flowing.

attire.title: Racer Chic
attire.desc: attire: A form-fitting red leather jumpsuit with bold black and white racing stripes down the sides and sleeves, featuring a prominent zip closure. Paired with chunky white sneakers. Accessories include a mirrored visor and large hoop earrings. Hair is pulled back into a sleek, high ponytail.

attire.title: Urban Gentry
attire.desc: attire: An impeccably tailored forest green tweed blazer with elbow patches, layered over a cream cashmere turtleneck. Paired with dark wash, straight-leg denim jeans and burnished leather Chelsea boots. A slim brown leather belt and classic aviator reading glasses complete the intellectual yet rugged look.

attire.title: Gothic Aristocrat
attire.desc: attire: A high-necked, long-sleeved black lace blouse with voluminous puff sleeves, tucked into a floor-length dark burgundy velvet skirt. Accessorized with a heavy silver cross pendant, intricate black lace gloves, and pointed toe black velvet ankle boots. Hair in a dramatic, severe updo.

attire.title: Punk Couture
attire.desc: attire: A distressed, oversized black leather biker jacket adorned with silver studs and chains, worn over a low-cut black silk camisole. Paired with high-waisted, acid-wash skinny jeans with strategic rips, fishnet stockings, and chunky platform combat boots. Multiple silver hoop earrings and a dark berry lipstick.

attire.title: Minimalist Luxe
attire.desc: attire: A pristine, oversized cream cashmere coat with clean lines and no visible fastenings, worn over a sleek black merino wool turtleneck sweater. Paired with tailored charcoal grey wide-leg trousers and minimalist white leather sneakers. A large, unstructured black leather tote bag and delicate gold hoop earrings.

attire.title: Retro Mod Pop
attire.desc: attire: A vibrant, short A-line shift dress in a bold geometric print of fuchsia, orange, and white. Paired with pristine white go-go boots, oversized white framed sunglasses, and a stack of colorful bangle bracelets. A sleek, blunt bob haircut completes the 1960s aesthetic.

attire.title: Seaside Glamour
attire.desc: attire: A flowing, pure white linen maxi dress with delicate lace inserts and a deep V-neckline. Paired with an oversized straw hat, delicate gold chain anklets, and flat leather sandals adorned with subtle seashell embellishments. A woven rattan clutch bag and rose-tinted sunglasses.

attire.title: Highland Chic
attire.desc: attire: A tailored red tartan plaid kilt-skirt with leather buckle details, paired with a fitted black cashmere sweater and knee-high black leather boots. A classic grey wool blazer with silver buttons and a small leather sporran-style bag complete the sophisticated Scottish-inspired look.

attire.title: Desert Bloom
attire.desc: attire: A flowing, wide-sleeved kaftan in burnt orange raw silk, with intricate white embroidery along the neckline and cuffs. Cinched at the waist with a wide, distressed leather belt. Paired with strappy leather flat sandals, layered silver and turquoise bangles, and a matching headwrap.

attire.title: Garden Party Whimsy
attire.desc: attire: A delicate pastel lavender organza midi dress with layers of ruffles and a subtle floral print. Paired with nude patent leather kitten heels, a small pearl-embellished clutch, and a single strand of pearls around the neck. Hair styled in soft, romantic waves.

attire.title: Arctic Explorer
attire.desc: attire: An oversized, plush faux fur coat in pristine white, extending to mid-calf. Worn over a thick, cream cable-knit sweater and sleek black faux leather leggings. Paired with shearling-lined black ankle boots and a chunky knit beanie hat in a matching cream color.

attire.title: Renaissance Rogue
attire.desc: attire: A loose-fitting, cream linen shirt with billowy sleeves, unbuttoned at the collar to reveal a silver medallion. Worn with high-waisted, dark brown leather breeches and tall, distressed leather boots. A wide, studded leather belt and a dark velvet cloak draped over one shoulder.

attire.title: Chic Equestrian
attire.desc: attire: A tailored navy blue riding jacket with brass buttons, worn over a crisp white collared shirt and a delicate silk ascot. Paired with form-fitting beige breeches and highly polished black leather riding boots. A slim leather belt and small stud earrings.

attire.title: Tropical Paradise
attire.desc: attire: A vibrant, off-the-shoulder maxi dress in a bold hibiscus and palm print on an electric blue background, made from light rayon. Worn with espadrille wedges, a delicate gold chain anklet, and a woven straw tote bag. A fresh flower tucked behind the ear.

attire.title: Dark Academia Maven
attire.desc: attire: A fitted dark forest green velvet blazer, worn over a cream silk button-down blouse with a subtle lace trim. Paired with a pleated black wool midi skirt, black opaque tights, and polished oxblood leather loafers. Round, tortoiseshell reading glasses and a leather-bound journal.

attire.title: 1920s Flapper
attire.desc: attire: A knee-length ivory silk dress adorned with rows of shimmering beads and fringe, designed for movement. Paired with a delicate feathered headband, long pearl necklaces, and T-strap heels. A small, intricately beaded clutch bag.

attire.title: Minimalist Utility
attire.desc: attire: A pristine white denim oversized jacket with structured pockets, worn over a simple black cotton t-shirt. Paired with tailored olive green cargo pants in a soft twill fabric and clean white leather sneakers. A functional, minimalist black crossbody bag.

attire.title: Urban Sporty Chic
attire.desc: attire: A black cropped bomber jacket in satin with subtle embroidered details, worn over a white oversized graphic t-shirt. Paired with high-waisted black track pants with a single white stripe down the side, and high-top designer sneakers. A baseball cap worn backward and a small backpack.

attire.title: Victorian Mourning
attire.desc: attire: A high-necked, long-sleeved black lace gown with a full skirt and intricate jet bead embellishments. Worn with long black lace gloves, a delicate cameo brooch, and black velvet ankle boots. A small black veiled hat and a somber expression.

attire.title: Tropical Grunge
attire.desc: attire: An oversized, distressed denim jacket with patches, worn over a vintage band t-shirt. Paired with a flowing, brightly colored floral sarong in red and yellow, and chunky black combat boots. Layered silver necklaces and dark red lipstick.

attire.title: Space Age Glam
attire.desc: attire: A shimmering metallic silver mini-dress with a high neck and long sleeves, featuring subtle textured patterns. Paired with thigh-high white patent leather boots, oversized futuristic sunglasses, and a sculptural silver ring. Hair in a sleek, high ponytail.

attire.title: Boho Witch
attire.desc: attire: A flowing, black velvet maxi dress with bell sleeves and a deep V-neckline, adorned with intricate silver embroidery. Worn with layered silver and obsidian necklaces, a wide-brim black felt hat, and dark leather ankle boots. A dark, flowing cloak completes the mystical look.

attire.title: Couture Military
attire.desc: attire: A sharply tailored olive green wool coat with gold epaulets and ornate brass buttons, cinched at the waist with a wide leather belt. Worn over slim black trousers and high-heeled black leather ankle boots. A gold medallion necklace and a severe, slicked-back hairstyle.

attire.title: Dark Fairy Tale
attire.desc: attire: A flowing, floor-length gown crafted from layers of sheer black lace and dark grey chiffon, featuring delicate embroidered spiderwebs. Worn with long, fingerless black lace gloves, silver antique-style jewelry, and black velvet ballet flats. Hair adorned with dark flowers.

attire.title: Eclectic Globetrotter
attire.desc: attire: A vibrant, patchwork silk kimono jacket featuring various global patterns, worn over a simple black camisole. Paired with loose-fitting black linen trousers and comfortable leather sandals. Layered beaded necklaces and a large, woven tote bag.

attire.title: Glamorous Goth
attire.desc: attire: A floor-length, off-the-shoulder gown in black stretch velvet, featuring a dramatic thigh-high slit and intricate silver chain detailing across the bodice. Paired with glossy black stiletto heels, a silver choker with a large pendant, and long black lace gloves.

attire.title: Sophisticated Safari
attire.desc: attire: A tailored beige linen safari jacket with multiple pockets and a belted waist, worn over a crisp white cotton shirt. Paired with slim-fit khaki trousers and sturdy leather ankle boots. A wide-brim felt hat and oversized brown sunglasses.

attire.title: Artisan Chic
attire.desc: attire: A hand-knitted oversized chunky sweater in various shades of natural wool (cream, grey, brown), worn over a long, flowing denim maxi skirt. Paired with comfortable suede moccasins, a multi-strand leather necklace, and large wooden hoop earrings.

attire.title: Opulent East
attire.desc: attire: A stunning silk brocade cheongsam in deep ruby red with intricate gold dragon embroidery, featuring a high collar and side slit. Paired with delicate gold filigree earrings, a jade bracelet, and black satin peep-toe heels. Hair in a sleek, traditional bun.

attire.title: High-Tech Sportswear
attire.desc: attire: A sleek, form-fitting black bodycon dress crafted from a high-performance stretch fabric with reflective silver accents. Paired with futuristic white platform sneakers, a minimalist silver choker, and a clear PVC visor.

attire.title: Romantic Vintage
attire.desc: attire: A delicate, tea-length dress in dusty rose lace, featuring a fitted bodice and a gently flared skirt. Paired with nude ballet flats, a small pearl necklace, and a vintage-inspired beaded clutch bag. Hair styled in soft, curled waves.

attire.title: Punk Rock Aristocrat
attire.desc: attire: A tailored black velvet blazer with silver stud embellishments on the lapels, worn over a ripped band t-shirt. Paired with distressed black skinny jeans, fishnet stockings, and patent leather Dr. Martens boots. Multiple silver chain necklaces and dark eye makeup.

attire.title: Cozy Cottagecore
attire.desc: attire: A loose-fitting, cream-colored linen blouse with delicate embroidery on the sleeves, paired with a long, gathered floral print skirt in soft greens and yellows. Worn with comfortable espadrille flats, a woven straw basket bag, and a simple ribbon in her hair.

attire.title: Glamorous Traveller
attire.desc: attire: A flowing, wide-leg jumpsuit in a rich terracotta silk, with a deep V-neckline and a cinched waist. Paired with oversized gold hoop earrings, a wide-brim straw hat, and comfortable leather slides. A large, chic canvas tote bag.

attire.title: Dark Romantic Poet
attire.desc: attire: A voluminous, high-necked black velvet dress with long, flowing sleeves and delicate lace cuffs. Worn with a silver locket necklace, black lace-up ankle boots, and a dark, dramatic lip color. Hair left loose and slightly windswept.

attire.title: Modern Equestrian
attire.desc: attire: A fitted black technical fabric riding jacket with subtle contrasting stitching, worn over a tailored white competition shirt. Paired with light grey stretch breeches and highly polished black leather tall riding boots. A minimalist watch and small stud earrings.

attire.title: Tweed & Silk Sophistication
attire.desc: attire: A sophisticated office look: a fitted Chanel-inspired jacket in a cream and navy houndstooth tweed, with pearl buttons, layered over a pure ivory silk camisole. Paired with a tailored navy pencil skirt that falls just below the knee and classic nude patent leather pumps. Accessories include a single strand of freshwater pearls and sleek reading glasses.

attire.title: Emerald Evening Glam
attire.desc: attire: A breathtaking evening gown in deep emerald green crushed velvet, featuring a plunging V-neckline and long, bell sleeves with delicate black lace cuffs. The dress boasts a cinched waist flowing into a full, A-line skirt with a dramatic train. Complementary accessories include strappy gold stiletto heels and a clutch bag encrusted with matching emerald crystals.

attire.title: Scarlet Latex Siren
attire.desc: attire: A bold, form-fitting midi-dress crafted entirely from vibrant scarlet red latex, featuring a high neck and long sleeves, with strategic cut-outs on the hips and ribs. Paired with matching scarlet latex thigh-high boots and a minimalistic silver chain necklace. A slicked-back hairstyle and glossy red lips complete this daring aesthetic.

attire.title: Gilded Brocade Dream
attire.desc: attire: An opulent two-piece set: a structured, peplum-style top and a matching high-waisted, wide-leg trouser, both in a luxurious gold and black floral brocade fabric. Accessorized with pointed-toe black velvet pumps, an oversized gold chain necklace, and a small, embellished black clutch. The top features a dramatic ruffled collar.

attire.title: Modernist Mohair
attire.desc: attire: A contemporary oversized cream mohair sweater dress, with exaggerated balloon sleeves and a mock neck, paired with contrasting black leather leggings. Completing the look are minimalist black ankle boots with a clear acrylic heel, and a large, structured geometric handbag in black and white.

attire.title: Punk Rock Tartan
attire.desc: attire: A rebellious ensemble featuring a red and black tartan mini skirt with safety pin embellishments, worn with a ripped black band t-shirt and a distressed black leather moto jacket. Accessorized with heavy silver chains, studded fingerless gloves, fishnet stockings, and chunky black combat boots.

attire.title: Lavender Lace Romance
attire.desc: attire: A delicate and romantic tea-length dress crafted from sheer lavender lace, lined with a silk slip of a slightly darker shade. The dress features delicate spaghetti straps and a flowing, A-line skirt. Paired with strappy silver kitten heels and a small, crystal-embellished clutch. Hair adorned with fresh lavender sprigs.

attire.title: Saffron Silk Draping
attire.desc: attire: A luxurious saffron yellow silk charmeuse evening gown, featuring an asymmetrical one-shoulder design with elegant draping across the bodice and a high slit on one side. Paired with delicate gold barely-there sandals and a chunky gold cuff bracelet. Hair styled in soft, cascading waves.

attire.title: Urban Utility Leather
attire.desc: attire: A chic utilitarian outfit: an olive green leather boiler suit with multiple pockets and a belted waist, styled with a contrasting black turtleneck underneath. Accessorized with high-top black leather sneakers, a structured black cross-body bag, and sleek, minimalist silver hoop earrings.

attire.title: Cobalt PVC Rainwear
attire.desc: attire: A striking ensemble centered around a long, trench-style coat made from glossy cobalt blue PVC, featuring oversized lapels and a matching belt. Worn over a simple black shift dress and paired with knee-high black patent leather boots. Accessorized with oversized white cat-eye sunglasses and a clear PVC umbrella.

attire.title: Crystal Embellished Gown
attire.desc: attire: A show-stopping ivory silk crepe de chine gown, intricately hand-embellished with iridescent crystals and micro-pearls across the bodice and sleeves. The gown features a high neckline, long sleeves, and a flowing skirt with a dramatic chapel train. Paired with silver strappy heels and delicate diamond stud earrings.

attire.title: Retro Mod Shift
attire.desc: attire: A vibrant 1960s-inspired mod shift dress in a bold geometric print of orange, pink, and white, with a high neck and short sleeves. Paired with white go-go boots and oversized white round sunglasses. A matching orange patent leather clutch completes the playful look.

attire.title: Olive Suede & Fringe
attire.desc: attire: A bohemian-luxe outfit featuring an olive green suede fringed jacket over a cream lace-trimmed camisole, paired with high-waisted dark wash denim flare jeans. Accessorized with tan leather ankle boots, a wide-brim felt hat in a matching olive shade, and layered gold coin necklaces.

attire.title: Architectural White Linen
attire.desc: attire: A minimalist yet striking ensemble: a structured white linen blazer with exaggerated shoulder pads and an open front, worn over a crisp white cotton bralette. Paired with matching wide-leg white linen trousers and sculptural white leather mules. Accessorized with an architectural silver cuff bracelet and square-frame sunglasses.

attire.title: Deep Burgundy Velvet Suit
attire.desc: attire: A sophisticated and rich tailored suit in deep burgundy velvet, featuring a slim-fit blazer with satin lapels and matching straight-leg trousers. Worn with a sheer black silk blouse featuring a pussy-bow tie. Paired with black patent leather loafers and a vintage gold pocket watch chain.

attire.title: Holographic Mini Dress
attire.desc: attire: A futuristic mini dress crafted from shimmering holographic fabric that shifts colors from pink to blue to green, featuring a high neckline and long sleeves. Paired with clear PVC knee-high boots with iridescent glitter heels and a chunky silver chain necklace. Hair in a high ponytail with metallic scrunchie.

attire.title: Nautical Striped Cashmere
attire.desc: attire: A luxurious take on nautical style: a fine-gauge cashmere sweater in classic navy and white stripes, worn over a crisp white collared shirt with a popped collar. Paired with high-waisted white wide-leg trousers and navy leather boat shoes. Accessorized with a delicate gold anchor pendant and a red silk neckerchief.

attire.title: Avant-Garde Organza
attire.desc: attire: An ethereal and dramatic outfit featuring a voluminous, layered gown constructed from sheer black organza, with intricate ruffles and pleats creating a cloud-like effect. The dress has an asymmetrical hemline and a high, ruffled collar. Paired with minimalist black strappy heels and long, fingerless black leather gloves.

attire.title: Sapphire Sequin Jumpsuit
attire.desc: attire: A dazzling jumpsuit entirely covered in shimmering sapphire blue sequins, featuring a deep V-neckline, long sleeves, and a wide-leg silhouette. Paired with metallic silver platform heels and a matching sapphire sequin clutch. Accessorized with large silver hoop earrings and a bold cocktail ring.

attire.title: Rust Corduroy Ensemble
attire.desc: attire: A vintage-inspired two-piece set in rich rust-colored corduroy: a cropped, fitted jacket with oversized pockets and a matching A-line mini skirt. Worn with a cream cable-knit turtleneck sweater. Paired with knee-high brown leather boots and a thick brown leather belt with a brass buckle.

attire.title: Pearl Adorned Tweed
attire.desc: attire: A sophisticated ivory tweed co-ord set, comprising a cropped jacket and a matching mini skirt, both intricately embellished with various sizes of faux pearls. Worn with a sheer white silk blouse with a high ruffled neck. Paired with delicate white leather pumps and a pearl-drop earring set.

attire.title: Fuchsia Feather Fantasy
attire.desc: attire: A show-stopping cocktail dress in vibrant fuchsia pink satin, featuring a strapless sweetheart neckline and an extravagant skirt entirely covered in cascading fuchsia feathers. Paired with matching fuchsia satin stiletto heels and a tiny, crystal-encrusted clutch. Hair swept up in an elegant chignon.

attire.title: Distressed Denim Couture
attire.desc: attire: A high-fashion take on denim: a tailored, deconstructed denim blazer with raw edges and strategic distressing, worn over a white ribbed tank top.
